The counter is made of dark wood with traditional Japanese-style drawers. A staff member in a uniform is seen behind the counter. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel recommendation and review for 'HOTEL En Michi' in Kawasaki, Japan. It emphasizes the budget-friendly price (approx. 1000 TWD per person), the convenient proximity to major train stations, and the unique artistic/traditional interior design inspired by the Edo period. It aims to attract budget-conscious travelers looking for a themed accommodation experience near Tokyo and Yokohama.
